import { parseArguments } from '../cli/arguments';
import type { Logger } from '../cli/logger.js';
import { join } from 'node:path';
export { mergeSpecs } from '../cli/arguments';
export * from './sibling';

/** Loads the help command lazily. */
export function loadHelp(log: Logger): Promise<unknown> {
  log.info(join('a', 'b'));
  parseArguments([], { strings: [], flags: [] });
  return import('../cli/commands/help');
}
